subject: rolling wildflower meadows with a solitary tree

world.caption: The scene is a panoramic, realistic depiction of a sprawling meadow under a vast, lightly clouded sky, exuding a peaceful and spacious atmosphere characteristic of a late-spring day. The gentle meadow slopes extend continuously around, creating an immersive natural environment. In the center, two rounded green hills, covered in a vibrant array of purple and orange wildflowers, dominate the immediate landscape. A solitary tree with distinctive warm orange-toned bark and a full, rounded canopy stands prominently on the crest of the rightmost hill. The hills seamlessly merge into the distance, where additional soft, undulating meadow slopes recede towards a distant horizon. Patches of wildflowers, mirroring those on the hillsides, dot the foreground and continue around the entire expanse of the meadow. The sky above is a clear blue, adorned with scattered, fluffy white clouds, indicating fair weather and soft daylight. The environment is devoid of any man-made structures, reinforcing the untouched natural beauty. A mild breeze subtly sways the wildflowers and grass, adding to the tranquil ambiance of the scene. The 360 scene is faultless.
